note: The models of World in the game (plan 0023, R1). Each entry: "id" is the name in the game, "order" is the order of World (World docs/factory.md), "levels" are the levels that the game uses, "impostor" is true for a model in rows and crowds (D5, R8), "uses" are the plans and the places, and "catalog" is the ID of the catalog of plan 0023, section 9. tools/world/fetch.py gets the files to assets/world/, and data/world/lock.json pins them.

blueprint.name: den_cong_vien
blueprint.doc: A lamp of the park and the walk of the sea of Bãi Trước: the blue pole with two arms (hai_tay), the dark post with five globes (den_cau), or the low square lamp of the paths (vuon_thap). Vũng Tàu, data/world/blueprints/den_cong_vien.json.
sources: The blue pole: photos of 2014-03-09 (Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0), 2017-02-01 (Flickr), 2019-04-30 (Tuổi Trẻ).
The post with five globes: photos of 2014-04-06 (Commons, trungydang, CC BY 3.0) and 2018-03-08 (Flickr).
The low lamp: photos of 2014-04-06 (Commons, trungydang, CC BY 3.0) and 2017-02-01 and 2018-03-08 (Flickr).
